entities.name: Fernando Velázquez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fernando Velázquez Saiz is a Spanish concert, film and TV composer. Among his best known works are the film soundtracks for Juan Antonio Bayona’s films: The Orphanage, The Impossible and A Monster Calls, for which he won the Goya Film Award for Best Original Composition in 2017.
